portals.name: Official city/regional land-administration evidence

portals.observation: The official Donetsk Oblast StateGeoCadastre maintains a dedicated cadastral and registration service section. Its current wartime notice describes suspension of user access to the state cadastre for listed combat or occupied administrative units; its 2026 notice describes a narrow new registration workflow for certain residential land plots in occupied/hostilities territories. This confirms registry administration, not an operating public registry in occupied Donetsk city.
